## ⚖️ RULED — 维护者,2026-08-30,第 5 场总监席决裁批 #9,verbatim「同意」(采本席推荐)

**裁定**:采**选项 A** —— **追认「`isSystem` 写入不在本控制范围内」为正式裁定**(系统写入系平台自写、合法跨租户;控制目标是应用面调用点)。"unscoped by design" 从此有裁决出处,不再只是一行注释。

- **执行(declared=enforced)**:守卫顺序与注释同笔改到把该 scoping **显式声明**——`bypassTenantAudit` 的 isSystem 分支旁注明本裁定与本卡号;控制的有效人口如实表述为应用面调用点(≈40/175),⛔ 不得再以「全部写入」的口径描述该控制。
- **stamper 缺口测量作为独立后续派发**:企业版 Middleware A 在围墙部署上是否使「调用点没带上下文」≠「行落 NULL」——它定 #13178 修复族的伤害等级(p1 vs p3),同笔另立测量卡。
- **#13178 暂缓的装置选择(CI 门/测试抛/启动报告)**:此后对诚实的应用面人口重估;若重估后仍需裁向,按批呈报。
- **回头条款**:若 stamper 测量发现系统写入真会落 NULL 租户行,本裁定回箱重裁。

**席位边界(裁不派)**:录裁 + 转 `pm:queue`,同笔摘 `needs-user-decision`;派发归车道席。裁决入本场追认摘要表。

Clause ②: **no** — nothing lands under `packages/spec/src/**`, and a scoping **declaration** changes neither what the contract accepts nor the public surface. ⚠️ That answer depends on the reading in the next paragraph; if the work turns out to change behaviour, it is not this seat's to wave through.

Picked up from `pm:queue` per the ruling's own 席位边界 line — 裁不派. Ruling recorded at `5470359920`… (批 #9, maintainer verbatim「同意」, adopting **option A**): 追认「`isSystem` 写入不在本控制范围内」为正式裁定.

### ⚠️ One phrase in the ruling has two readings, and they are materially different work

> **执行(declared=enforced)**:**守卫顺序与注释同笔改**到把该 scoping **显式声明**……

It can be read as **(a)** *"the guard order and the comment are changed together so the scoping is declared"* — i.e. actually reorder the guards — or **(b)** *"the guard-order-and-comment situation is changed, in one stroke, into an explicit declaration"* — i.e. make the declaration match what is already enforced, without moving behaviour.

⛔ **I am not choosing between them for the executor, and I am not re-adjudicating the ruling.** The dispatch carries the phrase verbatim plus a stop condition: `declared=enforced` most naturally means *bring the declaration up to what is enforced*, so if the executor finds that satisfying it requires **changing which writes actually get audited**, that is a behaviour change on a security surface and it **stops and reports** rather than deciding. Reporting that is a success outcome.

### The look-back clause is live, and it points at a card being dispatched alongside this one

> **回头条款**:若 stamper 测量发现系统写入真会落 NULL 租户行,本裁定回箱重裁。

That measurement is **#13497**, claimed in this same round. ⇒ This card's declaration could be re-opened by that card's result. Both are dispatched in parallel because the ruling created them in the same stroke and they do not contend (this one edits `driver-sql`; #13497 edits nothing), but the executor is told the clause exists so it does not write the declaration as if it were permanent.

**Serial constraints:** #13178 landed and is closed, so nothing else holds `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**` from this lane. ⚠️ Stated as partial: I did not enumerate open PRs' file lists repo-wide; the executor re-derives its write set against the merge base and confirms the single-writer path before its first edit.

## HELD — the ruling met its own look-back condition; nothing was taken out of draft

⛔ No PR was opened. ⚠️ Stated plainly, because it happened before the hold reached me: the
declaration text was already written **and pushed** as `ca3aacb073` on
`claude/issue-13491-issystem-scoping-declared`. Nothing has been pushed since; the changeset sits
in a deliberately unpushed local commit `5965611270`. Nothing was deleted, nothing enqueued, no
label touched, no assignee touched.

### 1. The forbidden "all writes" framing — every site, with what each said

Four sites carried it. All four are **already rewritten** in `ca3aacb073` (that is what the hold
caught mid-flight), so this is a list of what was found and what it now says, not a to-do list.

| # | Site | What it said | What it says now |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` — the `auditMissingTenant` docblock | "Surface writes that target a tenant-scoped object but don't carry a `tenantId`. **These are almost always system / seed / admin paths** that forgot to thread the active session context" — the control's subject stated as every unscoped write, with the sentence pointing at exactly the population that is excluded before the guard | Subject stated as the **application-surface** write; the exclusion, the population, the ruling and the look-back clause named; the guard-order rationale written down |
| 2 | `packages/drivers/driver-sql/README.md` — "Audit warning" | "Genuine system writes auto-silence; **everything else surfaces**" — false in the other direction too, since the posture gate silences the whole single-tenant case | Names the walled-posture precondition, the scope exclusion, and that a quiet log is an all-clear over the ~40 only |
| 3 | `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 24 | "Tenant-audit warning silenced … **Lose:** the signal that would flag a genuine user-path scoping bug" — frames the exclusion as a loss of in-scope coverage | Framed as a scope verdict; "Lose: nothing the control ever covered" |
| 4 | `packages/services/service-messaging/src/outbox-dispatcher-scope.ts` | "the driver's `auditMissingTenant` gate treats **every unscoped write** to them as a finding" | "an unscoped APPLICATION-SURFACE write … its scope stops there" |

⚠️ Two adjacent sites were **deliberately not touched** and are worth naming for the re-ruling:
`packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts` (fenced, and its text describes the option rather than the
control's population, so it does not carry the framing), and the package CHANGELOGs, which are
historical records rather than live descriptions.

### 2. The population arithmetic — what reconstructs, and what does not

**Corroborated on `main`, in two committed artifacts authored by the census's own PR (#13527):**
`.changeset/tenant-audit-update-delete-half-repairs.md` and the header of
`packages/services/service-storage/src/tenant-audit-update-delete-half-repairs.test.ts` both state
"**175** service write call sites against a tenancy-enabled object, **24** of them carrying no
tenant context at all".

**NOT corroborated anywhere:** the **135**. `git grep` over `packages/`, `scripts/`, `content/`,
`docs/` and `.changeset/` finds it in no committed artifact, and both #13178 and #13051 return
**HTTP 404** from the REST API (#13497, #13527 and #13541 return 200 from the same token, so this
is not an access or rate problem). The census's method is therefore unreachable, and ≈40 is
`175 − 135`, i.e. it inherits that number's unverifiability.

**The identity is internally consistent:** `135 / 175 = 77.1%` matches the card's 77%, and
`175 − 135 = 40` matches the ruling's ≈40/175.

**One decomposition the ruling did not state, and it sharpens the honest figure.** The 24 sites
"carrying no tenant context at all" must be a **subset of the in-scope 40, not of the 175**: a call
site that carries no context whatever cannot have `isSystem === true`, so it cannot be silenced at
the scope guard. That leaves roughly `40 − 24 = 16` in-scope sites that do carry a tenant and exit
at the `tenantId` guard — writes the control has nothing to say about because they are already
correct. ⇒ **the control's entire yield surface is the 24, not the 40**, and it has historically
produced 0 findings on them while all four known defects were found by people reading call sites.

**My own independent count, reported as a bound rather than a reproduction.** An AST walk (not a
text scan) over non-test sources: write-verb calls on an ObjectQL-engine receiver number **209**
across `packages/`, **220** including `examples/`. That is a superset of the census's number
because it does not filter to *tenancy-enabled* objects, which is the filter I could not apply
cheaply. It is consistent with 175 after such a filter; it does not reproduce it. ⛔ I did not
reproduce 175, 135 or 40 by measurement, and none of them should be read as re-verified here.

### 3. `declared = enforced`, if any of this survives

The two new test files are the part that is worth keeping whichever way the re-ruling goes, because
they measure rather than ratify: the engine branch that produces the exclusion is now pinned (delete
it and 2 pins redden), and the guard order is now pinned by the one thing reordering actually
changes (move the scope gate below the posture read and 1 pin reddens, while every warn/silence
assertion stays green). If the boundary moves, both pins move with it rather than standing in the
way.

- **Worktree**: `../objectstack-13491-object-tenancy` (off `origin/main`)
- **File surface**: expected `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (the blanket guard) + `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (the `bypassTenantAudit` isSystem mute gate) + tests. Per the ruling's point 7, ⛔ not `packages/spec/src/**`.
- **Clause ②**: the ruling **pre-adjudicates** it — 内容肢不触发 (runtime security behaviour change, the control IS this ruling, the human floor has been walked); path limb per your actual diff. ⛔ Do not re-open the content limb. **Still self-declare at claim time** — the ruling says so explicitly.

## Zone 1 — the maintainer's ruling, verbatim. ⛔ NOT re-adjudicable.

> **裁定:租户审计控制的范围按「对象的租户分类」切,⛔ 不按调用者旗子切。** 批 #9 的选项 A 裁定(「isSystem 写入不在本控制范围内」)按其自身回头条款(已由 #13497 测量触发)**收窄**为:
>
> - **isSystem × 租户范围对象 = 在范围内**。isSystem 写入租户范围对象而不带租户上下文,是控制必须抓的缺陷类——该类已发生五例(#12745 · #12928 · #10673 · #8617 · cloud#1239,其一为凭据表),历史上全部由人肉发现;
> - **isSystem × 真全局对象 = 出范围**。#8672 的理由(org-less 行对 `sys_permission_set` 等是 defensible 的)**逐对象**继承,⛔ 不再按 `sys_/cloud_/ai_` 命名空间批发豁免。
>
> **执行要点**:
> 1. **落点** = 把毯式 guard 收窄为逐对象租户性读取(schema 注入的 organization_id 列 + 写手事实为源),令租户范围 `sys_*` 流进已有的 derive/refuse 机器(含 #8844 多组织拒绝分支);`bypassTenantAudit` 的 isSystem 静音门同笔按同一分类收窄;
> 2. **一次性盘点**平台命名空间对象的租户性(有列且有写手填 = 租户范围;判不了的逐个列出回批呈裁,⛔ 不猜);
> 3. **方向必须响亮**:多出来的只能是拒绝/告警,⛔ 永不静默改写行为;预期红按翻转登记;
> 4. **#13178 修复族维持 p1**(采信 #13497 测量结论;⛔ 不降 p3);
> 5. **`orWhereNull` fail-open 豁免另立测量/设计卡**(本裁决同笔立卡),⛔ 不并本案、不做 rider;
> 6. **分支 `claude/issue-13491-issystem-scoping-declared`(`ca3aacb0`,旧口径声明文本)作废重派**——新派发按 C 口径重写声明与实现,⛔ 不基于旧声明续建(该分支自带的 5 项测量与 13 个 pin 可作输入引用);
> 7. **条款②预判**:按 2026-08-28 负边界裁定,本案属运行时安全行为变更、控制即本裁决(人工地板已走),内容肢不触发;路径肢按实际 diff(预计 engine + driver,不触 `packages/spec/src/**`);实现席 claim 时照常自判申报。

**R8.** No test may be skipped, disabled, quarantined, allow-listed, deleted or re-baselined.
**R9.** Worktree-first. ⛔ **Never `git stash`**.

### The three points most easily got wrong

**Point 6 — the old branch is VOID.** `ca3aacb0` was written to the *superseded* doctrine. Its five measurements and thirteen pins may be **read as input**; ⛔ nothing may be built on top of its declaration text. Start a new branch.

**Point 2 — the inventory has a mandatory escape hatch, and using it is success.** *判不了的逐个列出回批呈裁,⛔ 不猜.* An object whose tenancy you cannot determine goes on a list that comes back for adjudication. ⛔ Do not guess one either way to make the inventory look complete. A shorter inventory with an honest unknown list beats a complete one with a guess in it.

**Point 3 — direction is one-way.** Whatever the reclassification adds may only be **refusals or warnings**. ⛔ Never a silent rewrite of write behaviour. Expected reds get registered as flips, not smoothed over.

---

## Zone 2 — PM assumption to falsify

The blanket guard is `if (isPlatformNamespaceObject(object)) return undefined;` in `engine.ts` (`~:3765` at the time it was measured — locate it yourself, the file moves). I expect narrowing it to a per-object tenancy read is mostly *deleting* a short-circuit so tenant-scoped `sys_*` objects fall through into machinery that already exists — i.e. that the derive/refuse path needs no new capability.

**Falsify that.** If the existing derive/refuse machinery cannot in fact handle a platform-namespace object arriving at it — a missing column, an assumption about naming, a #8844 branch that keys on namespace — then this is a build, not an unblocking, and the shape of the card changes. Say which it is before you write much.

---

## STOP conditions

- The inventory's "cannot determine" list is large enough that the reclassification's blast radius is unknowable ⇒ report the list rather than pressing on.
- The work reaches for the `orWhereNull` fail-open ⇒ that is point 5's separate card. ⛔ Not a rider here.
- Anything would require a silent behaviour rewrite to keep tests green ⇒ stop; point 3 forbids it, and a green suite bought that way is the failure this ruling exists to prevent.
